title: unified-supervisor QA runner config
description: Isolated binaries and state roots for bun scripts/qa/unified-supervisor.mjs. The runner enforces this schema itself: unknown fields, missing required fields, relative or ~ paths, any path naming hub.sqlite, roots inside or containing production locations (~/.ferryx, Ferryx/mhc app-data directories, the invoking shell's FERRYX_DATA_DIR/FERRYX_RUNTIME_DIR/FERRYX_HUB_DB/FERRYX_HUB_CONFIG) or the home directory, and overlapping roots are refused with exit 2 before anything is written.

ferryxCli.description: Absolute path of the ferryx-cli binary built from the recorded source revision.

ferryxApp.description: Absolute path of the Ferryx desktop binary or app bundle from the same revision; directories are tree-hashed.

mhcBin.description: Absolute path of the mhc binary from the pinned capability-bearing revision.

dataRoot.description: Task-owned isolated Ferryx data root. Holds the ownership ledger (.qa-unified-supervisor/owned.jsonl) and per-run roots (runs/<runId>) that teardown removes.

memoryRoot.description: Task-owned isolated mhc memory root; per-run roots live under runs/<runId>.

projectRoot.description: Task-owned project/worktree root for the qa-supervisor fixture project.

pairedHostId.description: Paired host id for remote scenarios (remote-delivery, channels).

ownerPrincipal.description: Authenticated owner principal used by fixtures, e.g. qa-owner.

slackChannel.description: Dedicated QA Slack channel approved in the current execution session; omit or null when no approval exists.
